descripcion: At B1 you agree or disagree clearly and politely with simple phrases. The finer grading, like softened partial agreement, comes later — here the goal is a clear, polite reaction that still explains why you feel that way.

ejemplos.texto: I don't really agree with that.
Yes, that's true, but I think there's another side to it.

notas: I agree is the simplest and most common way to show agreement.
I don't agree is direct but still polite when said calmly.
Yes, but is useful when you agree with part of something but not all of it.

contraste.es: El español expresa acuerdo y desacuerdo de forma directa y muy similar (estoy de acuerdo / no estoy de acuerdo), así que la estructura se transfiere sin dificultad.

errores: Only saying yes or no without adding an opinion.

redemittel.expresion: I see what you mean, but…

traducciones.de: Ich verstehe, was du meinst, aber…
traducciones.fr: Je vois ce que tu veux dire, mais…
traducciones.pt: Percebo o que queres dizer, mas…

autochequeo: Have I clearly said whether I agree or not?
Have I added a reason or opinion, not just yes/no?
Have I used more than one phrase, not always the same one?
Have I used more than one phrase, not always the same one?
promptCorreccion: Focus only on agreeing and disagreeing clearly and politely. Check whether a reason follows the reaction and whether more than one phrase was used. Do not rewrite the text.
